outbox_lease_check.name: outbox_lease_check
outbox_lease_check.value: ("app"."outbox_job"."status" = 'processing' AND "app"."outbox_job"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."outbox_job"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL) OR ("app"."outbox_job"."status" <> 'processing' AND "app"."outbox_job"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "app"."outbox_job"."lease_until" IS NULL)

policy_scope_check.name: policy_scope_check
policy_scope_check.value: ("app"."policy_head"."kind" = 'commercial' AND "app"."policy_head"."warehouse_id" IS NULL) OR ("app"."policy_head"."kind" = 'warehouse_calendar' AND "app"."policy_head"."warehouse_id" IS NOT NULL)
